item.title: Billie Eilish, Angelina Jolie & FINNEAS Hit the Court for Support+Feed’s Inaugural Pickleball Benefit: Best Photos
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we bring you the latest updates from the world of entertainment. Today, we're talking about a fun event that brought together some big names for a great cause. Over the weekend, Billie Eilish and her family joined forces with stars like Kristen Bell, Angelina Jolie, and Dax Shepard for a game of pickleball, all in support of a good cause.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "The event, hosted by Support+Feed, a nonprofit founded by Billie's mom, Maggie Baird, aimed to raise awareness about food insecurity and environmental issues. The day was filled with games, delicious vegan and plant-based food, and even a pickleball tournament. Billie Eilish, along with her brother FINNEAS and his fiancée, Claudia Sulewski, were all in attendance, showing their support for the organization.
[Music continues]
Host: "The pickleball tournament saw twin national champions Ford and Boone Casady take home the top prize. But the real winner was Support+Feed, which raised money for its programs tackling climate change and hunger through plant-based food solutions. The organization has been working hard to provide relief to the local community, especially after the devastating Los Angeles wildfires in 2025.
[Music fades out]
Host: "It's great to see celebrities using their platforms to make a difference. And who knows, maybe we'll see more pickleball tournaments for a cause in the future. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one."
[Outro music plays]
